'''Theed Palace''' is the 32nd expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in December 2001. It is 131 cards (66 Light Side / 63 Dark Side + 2): 40 rares, 40 uncommons, 40 commons, 9 alternate-image cards, and 2 double-sided rules/checklist cards. Black border. CardGuide numbering: 32nd product (CardGuide lists 129). It is the last Decipher-printed expansion.

Sold in 11-card packs (MSRP $3.29: 1 rare or alternate image plus mixed commons/uncommons).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Print sheets ==
Rares, uncommons, and commons are 11&times;11 (121 cards). Commons and uncommons print on the same sheets. Each rare appears six times; for each alternate-image rare, 2 of those 6 are the AI version (except [[Naboo Celebration]] Light and [[Master, Destroyers!]] Dark, seven times each). Dark Side objectives print on the Light uncommon/common sheet.<ref name="encyc" />
